import hashlib,json,subprocess,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'work/ceres-v3/05/review-v6/standards-scope-check.json'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
file_sha=lambda p:sha(p.read_bytes())
review=json.loads((root/'work/ceres-v3/05/review-v6/review-scope.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
v6meta=json.loads((root/'work/ceres-v3/05/candidate-v6/baseline.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
v5meta=json.loads((root/'work/ceres-v3/05/candidate-v5/baseline.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
v6zip=root/'work/ceres-v3/05/candidate-v6/source.zip'; v5zip=root/'work/ceres-v3/05/candidate-v5/source.zip'; basezip=root/'work/ceres-v3/05/baseline/source.zip'
actual_review={p:file_sha(root/p) for p in review['paths'] if (root/p).is_file()}
review_mismatch=[{'path':p,'expected':h,'actual':actual_review.get(p)} for p,h in review['sha256'].items() if actual_review.get(p)!=h]
actual306={p:file_sha(root/p) for p in v6meta['sha256'] if (root/p).is_file()}
source_mismatch=[{'path':p,'expected':h,'actual':actual306.get(p)} for p,h in v6meta['sha256'].items() if actual306.get(p)!=h]
with zipfile.ZipFile(v5zip) as a,zipfile.ZipFile(v6zip) as b:
    na=set(a.namelist()); nb=set(b.namelist())
    changed=[]
    for p in sorted(na|nb):
        if p not in na or p not in nb:
            changed.append(p); continue
        if a.read(p).replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')!=b.read(p).replace(b'\r\n',b'\n'):
            changed.append(p)
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()
log=subprocess.check_output(['git','log','--format=%H%x09%s','5462e999d583a9bab6147d0b4141d98321f3cc92..HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines()
commits=[]
for line in log:
    if not line.strip(): continue
    commit,subject=line.split('\t',1)
    names=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff-tree','--no-commit-id','--name-only','-r',commit],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines()
    commits.append({'sha':commit,'subject':subject,'paths':names})
review_paths=set(review['paths'])
commit_overlap=sorted({p for c in commits for p in c['paths']} & review_paths)
base_expected=review['baseline_zip_sha256']; v6_expected=review['candidate_zip_sha256']
result={
 'captured_at_utc':__import__('datetime').datetime.now(__import__('datetime').timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'fixed_point':{'baseline_head_in_scope':review['baseline_head'],'baseline_zip_expected':base_expected,'baseline_zip_actual':file_sha(basezip),'baseline_zip_matches':file_sha(basezip)==base_expected,'commit_list_in_scope':review['commit_list']},
 'current_git_history':{'head':head,'commits_since_fixed_head':commits,'commit_path_overlap_with_review_scope':commit_overlap},
 'v6_candidate':{'zip_expected':v6_expected,'zip_actual':file_sha(v6zip),'zip_matches':file_sha(v6zip)==v6_expected,'source_path_count_expected':306,'source_path_count_metadata':v6meta['source_path_count'],'source_actual_count':len(actual306),'source_hashes_match':not source_mismatch,'source_mismatches':source_mismatch},
 'review_scope':{'path_count_expected':14,'path_count_listed':len(review['paths']),'actual_hash_count':len(actual_review),'hashes_match':not review_mismatch,'mismatches':review_mismatch,'owned_new_paths':len(review['owned_new_paths']),'production_paths':len(review['production_paths'])},
 'v5_to_v6_content_diff':{'v5_zip_actual':file_sha(v5zip),'v5_zip_expected_in_metadata':v5meta['source_zip_sha256'],'v5_zip_matches_metadata':file_sha(v5zip)==v5meta['source_zip_sha256'],'changed_paths_after_crlf_normalization':changed,'matches_declared_v5_delta':set(changed)=={'backend/tests/test_v3_live_sampling.py','work/ceres-v3/05/fixes.md'}},
 'observer_probe':{'run_dir':'work/ceres-v3/05/evidence/observer-malformed-selection-v6-http-boundary-20261005T232832Z-727a9df1','verification_sha256':file_sha(root/'work/ceres-v3/05/evidence/observer-malformed-selection-v6-http-boundary-20261005T232832Z-727a9df1/probe-verification.json')}
}
out.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='current_git_history'},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('current_git_head=',head,'commit_count=',len(commits),'scope_overlap=',commit_overlap)
